name: mcp-mesh-bridge
description: Reach an MCP server on a private network from Claude Desktop, signing in with OAuth.
long_description: Claude Desktop's connectors call MCP servers from Anthropic's cloud, which cannot reach a server on a VPN or a private mesh. This extension runs on your own machine instead: it relays Claude to the server's streamable-HTTP endpoint and back, and signs you in with OAuth in your browser. It knows no tools of its own; it passes on whatever the server offers.

server_url.title: Server URL
server_url.description: The MCP server's streamable-HTTP address, such as https://mcp.example.internal/mcp.

callback_port.title: Sign-in port
callback_port.description: The port on this machine your browser returns to after signing in. Leave empty for one chosen from the server URL.

client_id.title: Client ID
client_id.description: Only for a server that does not let clients register themselves: the client ID registered for this bridge.

client_secret.title: Client secret
client_secret.description: Only if that registered client has a secret.
